integrity: Exact module proof, two replayable matrix checkers; no independent validation or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-three linear two-row wave only; no conclusion for other characteristics or nonlinear dynamics.
Incidence rank for orders divisible by three remains a parameter; no classification of ternary ranks for arbitrary non-Desarguesian planes.
Computational examples do not replace the all-plane proof.
Historical priority is qualified by possible unindexed treatments; no independent mathematical validation.
title: Ternary incidence-rank clocks for reversible waves on finite projective planes
